subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake: minimal artifact list + reply templates
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lowe <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake: minimal artifact list + reply templates

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for starting the Type II intake. To keep this lightweight for your team, we put together a minimal artifact set and a few \"one-click\" reply templates your procurement/security reviewers can use when sharing items. Attached: a one-page summary (redwood-soc2-typeii-summary.pdf), a sample bridge-letter draft, and an artifact index CSV that maps each artifact to typical locations.

High-level guidance:
- Goal: provide a tight set of artifacts that will allow you to validate control coverage for the audit period without pulling every raw log.
- Turnaround target: 5 business days for the minimal set; if you prefer, we can stagger delivery (critical items first).

Minimal artifact list (what to share first):
1) SOC 2 report (Type II) if you have a current copy or a prior period — helps scope expectations.
2) Control owner contact list (roles + emails) for IAM, change mgmt, incident response.
3) Key policy snapshots: InfoSec, Access Control, Data Retention (PDFs or Drive links).
4) Sample audit logs: 7-day slice for prod auth events and admin actions (log export + description).
5) Backup/DR runbook summary and last test date.
6) Network diagram (high-level) and list of cloud regions used.

Quick reply templates (copy/paste ready) are in the attached doc. We recommend: (A) a short note for S3/SharePoint upload, (B) a presigned link template, and (C) redaction guidance if you need to mask PII.

If that matches what you were expecting, I can: (1) send an intake checklist to your security mailbox, (2) schedule a 20-minute intake call tomorrow, or (3) start a secure transfer link (S3 presigned or SharePoint). Which do you prefer?

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-typeii-summary.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: sample-bridge-letter.docx (DOCX)]
[Attachment: artifact-index.csv (CSV)]

From: Jordan Lowe <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake: minimal artifact list + reply templates

Alex —

Appreciate the concise list and the templates. A couple quick clarifications before we move to transfer:
1) For the \"sample audit logs\" slice, can you confirm formats you accept (CSV, JSON, zipped native logs)? Any size limits or preferred time window?
2) Is the bridge letter you shared intended to be a substitute for the report when the Type II hasn't been completed yet, or is it only for explaining coverage differences?
3) Our procurement team needs an estimate of how long redaction work might take if we need to remove customer PII from backups/logs.

We'll likely opt for a presigned S3 transfer (security inbox prefers that). Intake call sounds good — can you do 20 July at 10am ET?

Jordan Lowe
Security Engineering Manager
Acme Cloud

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lowe <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake: minimal artifact list + reply templates

Jordan —

Thanks — answers inline below and I added a couple options so your procurement can pick what fits.

1) Log formats & window: we accept CSV or JSON exports (gzipped OK). For auth/admin events a 7‑day slice is usually sufficient to validate event types and user/admin behavior; if you prefer we can accept a 30‑day rolling window but only request the first/critical 7 days initially. Max single-file size: 2GB; if larger, split or provide a manifest.

2) Bridge letter intent: the sample bridge letter is not a substitute for a full Type II report. It's intended as a short explanatory cover note when the most recent report doesn't cover the exact audit period or when you are sharing interim artifacts. It explains coverage, last test dates, and any control changes since the last report. Use it alongside the minimal artifacts, not in place of them.

3) Redaction estimate: depends on volume and tooling. Typical small uploads (<=10GB, structured logs) — 1–2 business days to run automated PII masking and produce the redacted exports. For larger or unstructured data we'll propose a plan after we see the artifact index. If you need a vendor statement: we can provide our redaction playbook excerpt (low friction).

Next steps options (pick one):
- A) I create an S3 presigned intake with lifecycle 14 days and an upload manifest.
- B) We send a share link to a secure SharePoint folder (Azure AD).
- C) We kick off a short intake call on 20 Jul at 10am ET (I'm available) and then provision transfer.

We can also accept encrypted email for the control owner list if that's easier.

If procurement prefers, feel free to loop in their intake alias and we'll send the SOW/transfer instructions.

Alex Martinez
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-typeii-summary.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: sample-bridge-letter.docx (DOCX)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lowe <security@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake: minimal artifact list + reply templates

Jordan / Procurement team —

Quick note from procurement side: presigned S3 (Option A) works for us. When you confirm we'll:
1) Share bucket name + manifest and create a single presigned PUT per file.
2) Provide a short checklist for redaction flags we check during intake.
3) Tag uploads with the HubSpot deal id (HS-987654) so ops can match artifacts to your request.

Jordan — if 20 Jul 10am ET is confirmed we'll send a calendar invite and attach the intake checklist.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
